text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Page triggered — Sev1 serving degradation in us-west-2-serving-1. Symptoms: repeated CUDA OOMs, container restart loops, and node-level network errors. Paging @oncall-sre and infra.

maria: I'm on the page, pulling logs now.

aj: seeing lots of `cudaMalloc` failures on serve-12 and serve-13, and mlx5 NIC drop counters climbing.

lina: Oncall here. What's the customer impact? timeouts or 5xx spikes?

ryan: APIs returning 503s and long tails. Runtime logs show `gdr: sendmsg timeout`, `rdma_cm: cq error` then `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY`.

jake: infra side — switch telemetry from leaf-13 -> rack-7 shows TX drops and policing events around 15:12 UTC. Looks like an egress policing rule triggered after a traffic burst.

amy: Support: we have 3 customers reporting increased 5xx (acme-co, betaworks, edu-labs). Putting them on incident page.

maria: Hypothesis: RDMA packet loss -> cross-node kvcache misses -> large refills and recompute -> memory pressure -> OOMs and restarts.

aj: Confirmed: kvcache cross-node miss rate spiked ~7x around same time. Runtime tries to rehydrate missing shards and memory usage balloons.

lina: Mitigation plan (short): 1) reroute traffic off rack-7 2) reduce `max_batch_size` on heavy routes 3) disable remote kvcache fallback 4) cordon high-error nodes. Assign roles.

jake: Starting reroute via trafficmgr — shifting ~30% traffic off rack-7 to us-west-1-drg. Will validate in ~60s.

incident-bot: Action logged: reroute initiated by infra-jake — ticket INC-2024-847.

ryan: Pushing `max_batch_size=1` to the heavy routes (gpt-rlhf) via console to lower per-request memory.

maria: Starting a canary: set `kvcache.remote_enabled=false` on two pods in rack-7 to validate.

aj: Also changing `gdr_retry_timeout_ms` to 2000 to reduce immediate failovers. Will monitor for side-effects.

jake: Switch team says policing was triggered by an autoscaler burst. They're coordinating to temporarily lift the policy and adjust rate-limiter config.

amy: Customer comms draft ready; will send update in 15m with current mitigation steps.

lina: I'll take incident commander. maria -> runtime lead, jake -> infra lead, aj -> runtime ops, ryan -> rollback guard.

maria: Canary results: memory stabilized on canary hosts, no further OOMs there. Latency 95th reduced by ~400ms.

aj: One node (serve-12) still throwing `kernel: mlx5: CQE error` and is in a restart loop. Recommend drain and reprovision.

lina: Agreed — cordon serve-12 and drain. Jake, ok to reprovision NIC and driver?

jake: Cordon done. Draining pods. I'll reprovision NIC and reinstall gdr driver on the host. New node alloc in progress.

incident-bot: Pager note: oncall backup @sre-lina will be primary in 30m if unresolved.

maria: Rolling the remote kvcache disable cluster-wide and keeping reduced batching. Error rate across affected routes dropped ~70%.

amy: Support update: acme-co now stable, betaworks sees intermittent 5xx but much improved.

aj: Tradeoff note: disabling remote cache increases compute/tokens but acceptable for stability now. Need plan for cost impact.

ryan: Observed a pod with `CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION` after restart on reprovisioned host — likely driver/firmware mismatch. Jake, please check host firmware.

jake: Reprovisioning host with updated firmware image now. NIC swap and driver reinstall in progress.

lina: Customer impact assessment: approximately 3% of prod traffic experienced degraded latency/errors for ~22 minutes from detection to stable reroute. We paged as Sev1 due to ongoing degradation; now moving to monitoring.

maria: Post-incident action items: 1) formal postmortem 2) autoscaler burst guardrails to prevent NIC saturation 3) KVCACHE miss ratio alerting and adaptive fallback 4) infra config change to avoid short-lived egress policing.

aj: I'll open an RFC for adaptive kvcache fallback and autoscaler smoothing.

jake: Switch team applied temporary policing lift and will schedule permanent change to rate-limiter to smooth spikes.

amy: Customer summary sent. No escalations received.

lina: Oncall handoff: I'll hand to @maria in 35m unless something regresses. If unresolved, escalate to eng-lead @ryan.

maria: Acknowledged. I'll complete the incident checklist and start the postmortem doc with metrics and timeline.

incident-bot: INC-2024-847 updated: mitigation applied, status=monitoring, assignees=[maria,jake,aj].

ryan: For postmortem: correlate autoscaler event (15:12 UTC), switch policing (15:13), container restarts (15:14-15:18). We'll extract pcap/telemetry for that window.

amy: Customer comms archived to #customer-comms.

maria: Final update: serve-12 reprovisioned, cluster stable for 45m, metrics normalized. Preparing detailed postmortem doc and follow-ups.

lina: Thanks team — marking for postmortem prep and closing in channel. :white_check_mark:
